verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents registrable outbound HTTP webhook callbacks for Google Cloud events. Budget notifications publish to Pub/Sub topics, not HTTP endpoints. The API hub push sync depends on a customer-deployed AWS Lambda or Azure Function relay, which is a user-side workaround. Personalized Service Health alerts are adjacent notifications, not programmatic webhook subscriptions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
